subject: [PATCH v3 2/5] NFSD: add a userspace-rpcbind flag to listener_set

2026-09-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a new 'userspace-rpcbind' flag to the listener_set interface, allowing callers to take over rpcbind registration from the kernel. The flag is echoed in the reply when accepted by the kernel, and the caller must not change ownership while a server exists. The patch also updates the netlink specification to include this new flag and its associated attributes.
